text: Many public libraries lend more than books: some offer museum passes, tools or seed packets. Check your branch’s catalogue before buying something you’ll use only once.
A shared tool cupboard in a block of flats can turn an awkward repair into a neighbourly exchange: one drill, kept in good order, serves many homes.
Spend three minutes watching a patch of ground for ants; notice where they travel and whether they carry anything, without disturbing their route.
